title: Field checklist
idea: Field checklist: A location-specific checklist groups mandatory and optional observations
audience: People who need to inspect field within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Work happens away from a reliable connection
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its inspect field priority and explicit commitment contract: Sync acknowledgement and local completion are separate
navigation: Field checklist keeps the current inspect field context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A location-specific checklist groups mandatory and optional observations
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect field; work happens away from a reliable connection
composition.priority: Sync acknowledgement and local completion are separate

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect field context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Expose remaining required items above final review
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the field checklist structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect field content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Sync acknowledgement and local completion are separate
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect field content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Sync acknowledgement and local completion are separate
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect field context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
